thread:
Jasper (marketing): ok team — Q3 ask: accelerate SMB onboarding playbook. need to finalize scope, sales targets, and enablement timeline by EOD friday. thoughts?
Priya (product): what does "accelerate" mean quantitatively? faster time-to-first-call? shorter POC? need launch criteria.
Liam (sales): goal: +18% new SMB ARR q/q if we reduce time-to-value. primary ask: simpler signup + 3 self-serve templates. can commit to driving trials if we have clear battlecards.
Maya (growth): PLG experiment idea: reduce signup steps from 6 -> 3 and show 1-click sample prompt preloaded for top verticals. track conversion funnel with cohort. low-risk A/B for 8 weeks.
Eve (enablement): we need 2 enablement assets: 1) 1-pager battlecard per persona, 2) 10-min demo video + FAQ. can create if product teams lock features by Tues.
Nora (customer-success): several mid-market customers asked for onboarding checklist and API quickstart. biggest friction is billing + model selection. customers want a guided flow.
Priya (product): propose phased scope: phase 1 (q3-early) = simplified signup, onboarding checklist, 1-click sample prompts, measurement. phase 2 = templates, deeper billing UX, self-serve commits. launch criteria for phase 1:
- < 48h average time-to-first-successful-inference for new accounts
- signup -> first-demo conversion >= 25% in A/B variant
- implement tracking for funnel + attribution
Jasper (marketing): that feels reasonable. what about go-to-market targets? Liam?
Liam (sales): target for phase 1 launch: net +12% SMB ARR uplift vs baseline over 90 days, and 150 new trials from self-serve flow. if we get battlecards, SDRs can follow up.
Maya (growth): experiment metrics I'll own: funnel steps, activation rate, retention at day 7. will instrument event list: `signup_start`, `signup_complete`, `first_prompt_run`, `trial_conversion`.
Eve (enablement): timeline check: if product locks Tuesday, I can have draft battlecards by Friday and final assets in 2 weeks. need 3 SMEs for interviews (Priya, Liam, Nora).
Priya (product): agreed. resource constraints: eng can allocate a 2-sprint effort for frontend + tracking. ops needs feature flag gating.
Jasper (marketing): PR/launch checklist: blog, support article, email to trialers, webinar. suggested launch window: week of Aug 10. is that still realistic?
Priya (product): Aug 10 ok for phase 1 soft launch if eng unblock happens. hard launch after 4 weeks of experiment results.
Nora (customer-success): can we include a concierge path for first 25 high-value trials? helps validate assumptions.
Liam (sales): yes, we'll identify target accounts and route to AEs. needs a short intake form (1-2 fields) so we can prioritize.
Jasper (marketing): owners: product = Priya, growth = Maya, enablement = Eve, sales ops = Liam, cs validation = Nora. I'll own the launch communications.
nudge-bot: reminder set for 2023-08-02 to check phase 1 lock status. :bell:
Maya (growth): small ask on scope negotiation: can we avoid templates in phase 1? templates take too long and block measurement. prioritize funnel simplicity.
Priya (product): agree — templates moved to phase 2. keep phase 1 tightly scoped.
Eve (enablement): confirm interview slots with SMEs today. I'll post a calendar invite.
Jasper (marketing): final quick list of launch KPIs to include in brief:
- time-to-first-successful-inference (median)
- signup -> demo conversion pct
- trial -> paid conversion (90d)
- number of trials from self-serve flow
- feedback qualitative themes (billing, model choice)
Liam (sales): add: ARR delta vs baseline for SMB cohort.
Priya (product): OKR draft for Q3 related to this: "Reduce average time-to-value for SMBs by 40% and increase self-serve conversion by 1.5x".
Jasper (marketing): great. action items: Priya — confirm eng allocation + FF plan by Tues; Maya — A/B variant plan + instrumentation by Wed; Eve — battlecard drafts by Fri; Liam — intake form & SDR plan by Fri; Nora — select concierge list by Fri. I'll compile brief and share. :thumbsup:
Liam (sales): noted. will sync with SDR leads.
Priya (product): tracker: I'll open a GH project for the work and share link here when ready.
Jasper (marketing): thanks all — quick standup on Thursday at 10 to surface blockers. closing thread. :v:
